cards.speaker: Sarah
cards.target: Bore da. Sut wyt ti?
cards.known: Good morning. How are you?

cards.speaker: Neighbour
cards.target: Dw i'n dda iawn, diolch. Ti'n mynd i'r gwaith?
cards.known: I'm very well, thank you. Are you going to work?

cards.speaker: Passenger
cards.target: Nac ydy, mae hi'n rhydd. Croeso i chi eistedd.
cards.known: No, it's free. Please, go ahead.

cards.speaker: Passenger
cards.target: Dyw hi ddim yn bell iawn. Falle tair neu bedair milltir.
cards.known: It's not very far. Maybe three or four miles.

cards.speaker: Barista
cards.target: Prynhawn da. Beth alla i gael i chi?
cards.known: Good afternoon. What can I get you?

cards.speaker: Sarah
cards.target: Prynhawn da. Licen i goffi,… os gwelwch yn dda. Gyda llaeth ond heb siwgr. I fynd.
cards.known: Good afternoon. … I'd like a coffee, please. … With milk but with no sugar. … To take away.

cards.speaker: Neighbour
cards.target: Noswaith dda, Siân. Gest ti ddiwrnod hir?
cards.known: Good evening, Siân. Did you have a long day?

cards.speaker: James
cards.target: Esgusodwch fi. Helo. Beth yw eich enw chi?
cards.known: Excuse me. Hello. What's your name?

cards.speaker: James
cards.target: James dw i. Neis cwrdd â chi.
cards.known: I'm James. Pleased to meet you.

cards.speaker: James
cards.target: Mae hon yn ddinas hyfryd. Beth dych chi'n neud?
cards.known: This is a lovely city. What do you do?

cards.speaker: Anna
cards.target: Am ddiddorol. Wel, neis cwrdd â chi.
cards.known: How interesting. … Well, lovely to meet you.

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Un. Dau. Tri. Gwyn. Du.
cards.known: 1. 2. 3. White. Black.

cards.speaker: Cafe Barista
cards.target: Bore da. Beth alla i gael i chi?
cards.known: Good morning. … What can I get you?

cards.speaker: Cafe Barista
cards.target: Wrth gwrs. Ydych chi moyn eistedd i mewn… neu fynd â fe?
cards.known: Of course. … Would you like to sit-in or takeaway?

cards.speaker: Cafe Barista
cards.target: Ar unwaith. Ydych chi moyn rhywbeth arall?
cards.known: Right away. … Would you like anything else?

cards.speaker: Cafe Barista
cards.target: Wrth gwrs. Dyma'r peiriant.
cards.known: Of course. … There's the machine.

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Pump. Deg. Un deg pump. Coch. Gwyrdd.
cards.known: 5. 10. 15. Red. Green.

cards.speaker: Bartender
cards.target: Noswaith dda. Beth alla i gael i chi?
cards.known: Good evening. What can I get you?

cards.speaker: Bar Customer 3
cards.target: Alla i weld y rhestr win? Dw i moyn gwydraid o win.
cards.known: Could I see the wine list? … I want a glass of wine.

cards.speaker: Bar Customer 2
cards.target: Oes brechdanau 'da chi? Licen i frechdan gaws,… os gwelwch yn dda.
cards.known: Do you have any sandwiches? … I'd like a cheese sandwich, please.

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Pedwar. Chwech. Wyth. Glas. Melyn.
cards.known: 4. 6. 8. Blue. Yellow.

cards.speaker: Diner 1
cards.target: Noswaith dda. Ma bwcin gyda ni i ddau,… o dan yr enw Davies.
cards.known: Good evening. … We have a booking for two, under the name Davies.

cards.speaker: Diner 1
cards.target: Esgusodwch fi —… oes gyda chi rywbeth… heb glwten? Neu i lysieuwyr?
cards.known: Excuse me - do you have anything gluten-free? … Or for vegetarians?

cards.speaker: Waiter
cards.target: Dewis ardderchog. Do i ag e draw nawr.
cards.known: Excellent choice. I'll bring it right over.

cards.speaker: Waiter
cards.target: Ydy popeth yn iawn? Oes lle gyda chi i bwdin?
cards.known: Is everything alright? Do you have any room for dessert?

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Saith. Naw. Un deg un. Oren. Porffor.
cards.known: 7. 9. 11. Orange. Purple.

cards.speaker: Customer
cards.target: Diolch,… dych chi wedi bod yn help mawr. Dw i'n ddiolchgar iawn.
cards.known: Thank you, you've been very helpful. … I'm very grateful.

cards.speaker: Guest
cards.target: Wrth gwrs. Dyma fy mhasbort i.
cards.known: Of course. Here's my passport.

cards.speaker: Receptionist
cards.target: O hanner awr wedi saith… tan ddeg o'r gloch. Ma 'da ni ffrwythau a grawnfwyd… neu frecwast… wedi'i goginio.
cards.known: From half-past seven until ten o'clock. … We have fruit and cereals or a cooked breakfast.

cards.speaker: Guest
cards.target: Gwych. Ydy hi'n bosib… i ni ga'l check-out hwyr?
cards.known: Wonderful. Is it possible for us to have a late check-out?

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Un deg chwech. Un deg saith. Un deg wyth. Dydd Llun. Dydd Mawrth.
cards.known: 16. 17. 18. Monday. Tuesday.

cards.speaker: Pharmacist
cards.target: Wrth gwrs. Beth yw eich symptomau chi?
cards.known: Of course. What are your symptoms?

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Un deg naw. Dau ddeg. Dau ddeg un. Dydd Mercher. Dydd Iau.
cards.known: 19. 20. 21. Wednesday. Thursday.

cards.speaker: Tourist
cards.target: Diolch yn fawr iawn. Dych chi wedi bod yn help mawr.
cards.known: Thank you very much. … You've been very helpful.

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Tri deg. Pedwar deg. Pum deg. Dydd Gwener. Dydd Sadwrn.
cards.known: 30. 40. 50. Friday. Saturday.

cards.speaker: Driver
cards.target: Galla, wrth gwrs. Falle bydd hi'n cymryd… tipyn o amser,… ma 'na lot o draffig… ar hyn o bryd.
cards.known: Yes, of course. … It may take some time, there's a lot of traffic at the moment.

cards.speaker: Driver
cards.target: Gallwch, wrth gwrs. Ma'r peiriant… jyst fan hyn.
cards.known: Yes, of course. … The machine is just here.

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Cant. Dau gant. Mil. Dydd Sul. Deuddeg o'r gloch.
cards.known: 100. 200. 1000. Sunday. 12 o'clock.

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Can mil. Chwe deg. Saith deg. Un o'r gloch. Un ar ddeg o'r gloch.

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Miliwn. Wyth deg. Naw deg. Dau o'r gloch. Deg o'r gloch.
cards.known: A million. 80. 90. 2 o'clock. 10 o'clock.

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Tri o'r gloch. Naw o'r gloch. Ionawr. Chwefror.
cards.known: 3 o'clock. 9 o'clock. January. February.

cards.speaker: Learner
cards.target: Ydy hynny'n gywir? Ydw i'n gywir?
cards.known: Is that correct? Am I correct?

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Pedwar o'r gloch. Wyth o'r gloch. Mawrth. Ebrill.
cards.known: 4 o'clock. 8 o'clock. March. April.

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Pump o'r gloch. Saith o'r gloch. Mai. Mehefin.
cards.known: 5 o'clock. 7 o'clock. May. June.

cards.speaker: Narrator
cards.target: Chwech o'r gloch. Gorffennaf. Awst. Medi.
cards.known: 6 o'clock. July. August. September.

cards.speaker: Learner
cards.target: Hydref. Tachwedd. Rhagfyr.
cards.known: October. November. December.
